/* ==============================================================================
 * INCLUDES
 * =============================================================================*/

#include "sstep.h"

#include <stddef.h>

#include "sstep_internal.h"

/* ==============================================================================
 * DEFINES & MACROS
 * =============================================================================*/

#define TWO_PI_NUM 710U
#define TWO_PI_DEN 113U

#define RATIO_LIMIT ((uint64_t)1U << 62U)

#define VALUE_MAX 10000000U

#define Q16_LIMIT ((int64_t)0x40000000)

#define VBUS_PU_MAX SSTEP_ACC_SCALE_MAX

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE TYPE DEFINITIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

/* Alignment probes: sizeof(probe) - sizeof(x) is the alignment of the type of x
   (no _Alignof, Rule 1.4; no offsetof, which the static analysis cannot resolve) */
struct align_ctx
{
    char c;
    struct sstep_ctx x;
};

struct align_pub
{
    char c;
    struct sstep x;
};

/* The opaque public instance must hold the private driver state */
_Static_assert(sizeof(struct sstep_config) <= SSTEP_CONFIG_BYTES,
               "SSTEP_CONFIG_BYTES in sstep_ctrl.h is too small for this ABI");
_Static_assert(sizeof(struct sstep_ctx) <= sizeof(struct sstep),
               "SSTEP_STATE_BYTES in sstep_ctrl.h is too small");
_Static_assert((sizeof(struct align_ctx) - sizeof(struct sstep_ctx)) <=
                   (sizeof(struct align_pub) - sizeof(struct sstep)),
               "struct sstep is not aligned for struct sstep_ctx");

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE FUNCTION DECLARATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

static bool is_pow2(uint32_t v);
static uint8_t log2_u32(uint32_t v);
static bool mul_ok(uint64_t a, uint64_t b, uint64_t* out);
static int ratio(uint64_t n1, uint64_t n2, uint64_t d1, uint64_t d2, struct sstep_gain* g);
static int64_t div_round(int64_t num, int64_t den);
static int64_t pow2_i64(uint32_t n);
static sstep_real_t gain_apply_i32(const struct sstep_gain* g, int32_t v);
static sstep_angle_t raw_angle(const struct sstep_ctx* m, int64_t pos);
static int check_config(const struct sstep_config* cfg);
static int check_stall(const struct sstep_config* cfg);
static int derive_stall(struct sstep_ctx* m);
static int set_currents(struct sstep_ctx* m, uint32_t run_ma, uint32_t hold_ma);
static int set_limits(struct sstep_ctx* m, uint32_t v_max, uint32_t accel, uint32_t decel);
static int derive(struct sstep_ctx* m);
static void shutdown(struct sstep_ctx* m, uint16_t faults);
static void publish(struct sstep_ctx* m, const struct sstep_setpoint* sp);
static bool is_active(enum sstep_state s);
static bool is_moving(const struct sstep_ctx* m);
static void control(struct sstep_ctx* m);

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

static bool is_pow2(uint32_t v)
{
    return (v != 0U) && ((v & (v - 1U)) == 0U);
}

static uint8_t log2_u32(uint32_t v)
{
    uint8_t n = 0U;
    uint32_t x = v;
    while (x > 1U)
    {
        x >>= 1U;
        n++;
    }
    return n;
}

static bool mul_ok(uint64_t a, uint64_t b, uint64_t* out)
{
    bool ok = (a == 0U) || (b < (RATIO_LIMIT / a));
    *out = ok ? (a * b) : 0U;
    return ok;
}

static int ratio(uint64_t n1, uint64_t n2, uint64_t d1, uint64_t d2, struct sstep_gain* g)
{
    int result = SSTEP_ERR_CONFIG;
    uint64_t n;
    uint64_t d;
    if (mul_ok(n1, n2, &n) && mul_ok(d1, d2, &d) &&
        (sstep_gain_from_ratio64((int64_t)n, (int64_t)d, g) == SSTEP_OK))
    {
        result = SSTEP_OK;
    }
    return result;
}

static int64_t div_round(int64_t num, int64_t den)
{
    return (num >= 0) ? ((num + (den / 2)) / den) : -((-num + (den / 2)) / den);
}

static int64_t pow2_i64(uint32_t n)
{
    uint64_t p = (uint64_t)1U << n;
    return (int64_t)p;
}

static sstep_real_t gain_apply_i32(const struct sstep_gain* g, int32_t v)
{
#if (SSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND == SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FIXED)
    int64_t p = (int64_t)v * (int64_t)g->mant; /* value * 2^15 = p * 2^exp */
    int32_t e = (int32_t)g->exp;
    int64_t q;
    if (e >= 0)
    {
        q = p * pow2_i64((uint32_t)e); /* |p| < 2^46, exp <= 15 */
    }
    else
    {
        e = -e;
        q = div_round(p, pow2_i64((uint32_t)e));
    }
    if (q > (int64_t)INT16_MAX)
    {
        q = (int64_t)INT16_MAX;
    }
    else if (q < (int64_t)INT16_MIN)
    {
        q = (int64_t)INT16_MIN;
    }
    else
    {
        /* in range */
    }
    return (sstep_real_t)q;
#else
    return sstep_sat_f(g->value * (float)v);
#endif
}

static sstep_angle_t raw_angle(const struct sstep_ctx* m, int64_t pos)
{
    return (sstep_angle_t)(((uint64_t)pos) << m->angle_shift); /* modulo one turn */
}

static int check_config(const struct sstep_config* cfg)
{
    const struct sstep_motor_cfg* mo = &cfg->motor;
    const struct sstep_stage_cfg* st = &cfg->stage;
    const struct sstep_ctrl_cfg* c = &cfg->ctrl;
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if ((cfg->hal.pwm_write == NULL) || (cfg->hal.output_enable == NULL) || (mo->r_mohm == 0U) ||
        (mo->r_mohm > VALUE_MAX) || (mo->l_uh == 0U) || (mo->l_uh > VALUE_MAX) ||
        (mo->i_rated_ma == 0U) || (mo->i_rated_ma > VALUE_MAX) ||
        (mo->ke_uv_s_per_rad > VALUE_MAX) || (mo->full_steps_per_rev == 0U) ||
        ((st->topology != SSTEP_TOPOLOGY_FULL_BRIDGE) &&
         (st->topology != SSTEP_TOPOLOGY_SHARED_LEG)) ||
        (st->vbus_nominal_mv == 0U) || (st->vbus_nominal_mv > VALUE_MAX) ||
        (st->vbus_min_mv > VALUE_MAX) || (st->vbus_max_mv > VALUE_MAX) ||
        (st->i_full_scale_ma == 0U) || (st->i_full_scale_ma > VALUE_MAX) || (st->i_trip_ma == 0U) ||
        (st->pwm_period_ticks < 2U) || (st->adc_i_span == 0) || (st->adc_i_span > 65535) ||
        (st->adc_i_span < -65535) || (st->adc_full == 0U) || (st->adc_i_zero > st->adc_full) ||
        (st->adc_vbus_mv_full == 0U) || (st->adc_vbus_mv_full > VALUE_MAX) ||
        ((c->drive_mode != SSTEP_DRIVE_CURRENT) && (c->drive_mode != SSTEP_DRIVE_VOLTAGE)) ||
        (c->fast_loop_hz == 0U) || (c->slow_loop_hz == 0U) || (c->fast_loop_hz > VALUE_MAX) ||
        (!is_pow2(c->microsteps)) || (c->microsteps > SSTEP_CFG_MICROSTEPS_MAX) ||
        (c->current_bw_hz == 0U) || (c->i_run_ma == 0U) || (c->v_max == 0U) || (c->accel == 0U))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
#if (SSTEP_CFG_TOPOLOGY_FULL_BRIDGE == 0)
    else if (st->topology == SSTEP_TOPOLOGY_FULL_BRIDGE)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_UNSUPPORTED;
    }
#endif
#if (SSTEP_CFG_TOPOLOGY_SHARED_LEG == 0)
    else if (st->topology == SSTEP_TOPOLOGY_SHARED_LEG)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_UNSUPPORTED;
    }
#endif
    else if ((st->i_trip_ma > st->i_full_scale_ma) || ((c->fast_loop_hz % c->slow_loop_hz) != 0U) ||
             ((c->fast_loop_hz / c->slow_loop_hz) > 65535U) ||
             (c->current_bw_hz > (c->fast_loop_hz / 4U)) ||
             ((st->vbus_min_mv != 0U) && (st->vbus_min_mv >= st->vbus_nominal_mv)) ||
             ((st->vbus_max_mv != 0U) && (st->vbus_max_mv <= st->vbus_nominal_mv)))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_CONFIG;
    }
    else
    {
        result = check_stall(cfg);
    }
    return result;
}

static int check_stall(const struct sstep_config* cfg)
{
    const struct sstep_ctrl_cfg* c = &cfg->ctrl;
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if (c->stall_time_ms == 0U)
    {
        /* stall detection off */
    }
    else if ((c->stall_time_ms > VALUE_MAX) || (c->stall_filter_us == 0U) ||
             (c->stall_filter_us > VALUE_MAX) || (c->stall_speed == 0U) ||
             (c->stall_speed > VALUE_MAX) || (c->stall_sync_pct == 0U) ||
             (c->stall_sync_pct > 100U))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if ((c->drive_mode != SSTEP_DRIVE_CURRENT) || (cfg->motor.ke_uv_s_per_rad == 0U) ||
             (((uint64_t)c->stall_filter_us * c->fast_loop_hz) < 1000000U))
    {
        /* the observer needs measured currents, Ke, and tau >= Ts */
        result = SSTEP_ERR_CONFIG;
    }
    else
    {
        /* consistent */
    }
    return result;
}

static int derive_stall(struct sstep_ctx* m)
{
    const struct sstep_motor_cfg* mo = &m->cfg.motor;
    const struct sstep_stage_cfg* st = &m->cfg.stage;
    const struct sstep_ctrl_cfg* c = &m->cfg.ctrl;
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if (c->stall_time_ms != 0U)
    {
        uint64_t ticks = ((uint64_t)c->stall_time_ms * c->slow_loop_hz) / 1000U;
        /* back-EMF of stall_speed: Ke 2 pi v / (Ns M) [uV], every factor below 10^7 */
        uint64_t e_thr_uv = ((uint64_t)c->stall_speed * mo->ke_uv_s_per_rad * TWO_PI_NUM) /
                            ((uint64_t)TWO_PI_DEN * mo->full_steps_per_rev * c->microsteps);
        uint64_t e_thr_mv = (e_thr_uv + 500U) / 1000U;
        /* L / Ts and R / 2 in uOhm: l_uh fs and 500 r_mohm */
        uint64_t l_fs = (uint64_t)mo->l_uh * c->fast_loop_hz;
        uint64_t r_half = (uint64_t)mo->r_mohm * 500U;
        bool b_negative = (l_fs < r_half);

        /* a, b = (L / Ts +/- R / 2) I_base / V_base; Ts / tau = 10^6 / (fs tau_us) <= 1 */
        result =
            ratio(l_fs + r_half, st->i_full_scale_ma, 1000000U, st->vbus_nominal_mv, &m->emf_a);
        if (result == SSTEP_OK)
        {
            result = ratio(b_negative ? (r_half - l_fs) : (l_fs - r_half), st->i_full_scale_ma,
                           1000000U, st->vbus_nominal_mv, &m->emf_b);
            if (b_negative)
            {
                /* R Ts / 2 > L: a very small inductance */
#if (SSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND == SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FIXED)
                m->emf_b.mant = (int16_t)(-m->emf_b.mant);
#else
                m->emf_b.value = -m->emf_b.value;
#endif
            }
        }
        if (result == SSTEP_OK)
        {
            result = ratio(1000000U, 1U, c->fast_loop_hz, c->stall_filter_us, &m->emf_alpha);
        }
        if ((result == SSTEP_OK) && ((ticks == 0U) || (ticks > UINT32_MAX) || (e_thr_mv == 0U) ||
                                     (e_thr_mv >= st->vbus_nominal_mv)))
        {
            /* shorter than a slow period, or a threshold below 1 mV or above the bus */
            result = SSTEP_ERR_CONFIG;
        }
        if (result == SSTEP_OK)
        {
            m->stall_ticks = (uint32_t)ticks;
            m->stall_emf_mv = (int32_t)e_thr_mv;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

static int set_currents(struct sstep_ctx* m, uint32_t run_ma, uint32_t hold_ma)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;
    sstep_real_t run;
    sstep_real_t hold;

    if ((run_ma == 0U) || (run_ma > VALUE_MAX) || (hold_ma > VALUE_MAX))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if ((hold_ma > run_ma) || (run_ma > m->cfg.stage.i_trip_ma) ||
             (run_ma > m->cfg.motor.i_rated_ma))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_CONFIG;
    }
    else
    {
        int32_t base = (int32_t)m->cfg.stage.i_full_scale_ma;
        (void)sstep_real_from_ratio((int32_t)run_ma, base, &run); /* base > 0 */
        (void)sstep_real_from_ratio((int32_t)hold_ma, base, &hold);
        m->i_run = run;
        m->i_hold = hold;
        m->cfg.ctrl.i_run_ma = run_ma;
        m->cfg.ctrl.i_hold_ma = hold_ma;
    }
    return result;
}

static int set_limits(struct sstep_ctx* m, uint32_t v_max, uint32_t accel, uint32_t decel)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;
    int64_t f = (int64_t)m->cfg.ctrl.slow_loop_hz;
    uint32_t dec_in = (decel == 0U) ? accel : decel;
    int64_t vq = div_round((int64_t)v_max * SSTEP_POS_ONE, f);
    int64_t aq = div_round((int64_t)accel * SSTEP_POS_ONE, f * f);
    int64_t dq = div_round((int64_t)dec_in * SSTEP_POS_ONE, f * f);

    if ((v_max == 0U) || (accel == 0U) || (vq < 1) || (vq >= Q16_LIMIT) || (aq < 1) ||
        (aq >= Q16_LIMIT) || (dq < 1) || (dq >= Q16_LIMIT))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else
    {
        m->mo.v_max = (int32_t)vq;
        m->mo.acc = (int32_t)aq;
        m->mo.dec = (int32_t)dq;
        m->mo.brake_vmax = (vq * vq) / (2 * dq);
        m->cfg.ctrl.v_max = v_max;
        m->cfg.ctrl.accel = accel;
        m->cfg.ctrl.decel = decel;
    }
    return result;
}

static int derive(struct sstep_ctx* m)
{
    const struct sstep_motor_cfg* mo = &m->cfg.motor;
    const struct sstep_stage_cfg* st = &m->cfg.stage;
    const struct sstep_ctrl_cfg* c = &m->cfg.ctrl;
    uint64_t span = (uint64_t)((st->adc_i_span < 0) ? -st->adc_i_span : st->adc_i_span);
    uint64_t bw2pi = (uint64_t)c->current_bw_hz * TWO_PI_NUM;
    uint64_t vmv = st->vbus_nominal_mv;
    uint64_t trip = ((uint64_t)st->i_trip_ma * span) / st->i_full_scale_ma;
    uint64_t vmax_raw = ((uint64_t)st->vbus_max_mv * st->adc_full) / st->adc_vbus_mv_full;
    uint64_t vmin_raw = (((uint64_t)st->vbus_min_mv * st->adc_full) + st->adc_vbus_mv_full - 1U) /
                        st->adc_vbus_mv_full;
    int result;

    /* Kp = L wc I_base / V_base, Ki Ts = R wc Ts I_base / V_base, Kb = Ts R / L */
    result = ratio((uint64_t)mo->l_uh * st->i_full_scale_ma, bw2pi, (uint64_t)TWO_PI_DEN * 1000000U,
                   vmv, &m->kp);
    if (result == SSTEP_OK)
    {
        result = ratio((uint64_t)mo->r_mohm * st->i_full_scale_ma, bw2pi,
                       (uint64_t)TWO_PI_DEN * 1000U, (uint64_t)c->fast_loop_hz * vmv, &m->ki);
    }
    if (result == SSTEP_OK)
    {
        result = ratio(mo->r_mohm, 1000U, c->fast_loop_hz, mo->l_uh, &m->kb);
    }
    if (result == SSTEP_OK)
    {
        result = ratio(mo->r_mohm, st->i_full_scale_ma, 1000U, vmv, &m->r_pu);
    }
    if (result == SSTEP_OK)
    {
        result = ratio(1U, 1U, span, 1U, &m->adc_i);
        if (st->adc_i_span < 0)
        {
#if (SSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND == SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FIXED)
            m->adc_i.mant = (int16_t)(-m->adc_i.mant);
#else
            m->adc_i.value = -m->adc_i.value;
#endif
        }
    }
    if (result == SSTEP_OK)
    {
        result = ratio(st->adc_vbus_mv_full, 1U, st->adc_full, vmv, &m->adc_v);
    }
    if (result == SSTEP_OK)
    {
        /* back-EMF per microstep/s: Kt 2 pi / (Ns M) / V_base */
        result = ratio(mo->ke_uv_s_per_rad, TWO_PI_NUM,
                       (uint64_t)TWO_PI_DEN * mo->full_steps_per_rev * c->microsteps, vmv * 1000U,
                       &m->ff_gain);
    }
    /* trip <= span <= 65535 because i_trip_ma <= i_full_scale_ma (check_config) */
    if ((result == SSTEP_OK) && (trip == 0U))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_CONFIG;
    }
    if (result == SSTEP_OK)
    {
        result = set_currents(m, c->i_run_ma, c->i_hold_ma);
    }
    if (result == SSTEP_OK)
    {
        result = set_limits(m, c->v_max, c->accel, c->decel);
    }
    if (result == SSTEP_OK)
    {
        result = derive_stall(m);
    }
    if (result == SSTEP_OK)
    {
        m->i_trip_counts = (uint16_t)trip;
        m->vbus_max_raw = (uint16_t)((vmax_raw > 65535U) ? 65535U : vmax_raw);
        m->vbus_min_raw = (uint16_t)((vmin_raw > 65535U) ? 65535U : vmin_raw);
        m->ratio = (uint16_t)(c->fast_loop_hz / c->slow_loop_hz);
        m->hold_ticks = (uint32_t)(((uint64_t)c->hold_delay_ms * c->slow_loop_hz) / 1000U);
        m->angle_shift = (uint8_t)(14U - log2_u32(c->microsteps));
        (void)sstep_gain_from_ratio(1, 1, &m->inv_vbus); /* nominal until measured */
    }
    return result;
}

static void shutdown(struct sstep_ctx* m, uint16_t faults)
{
    m->faults = (uint16_t)(m->faults | faults);
    m->state = SSTEP_STATE_FAULT;
    (void)m->cfg.hal.output_enable(m->cfg.hal.context, false);
    if (m->cfg.hal.on_fault != NULL)
    {
        m->cfg.hal.on_fault(m->cfg.hal.context, faults);
    }
}

static void publish(struct sstep_ctx* m, const struct sstep_setpoint* sp)
{
    uint8_t w;
    m->sp_pending = 0U;
    w = (uint8_t)(1U - m->sp_active);
    m->sp[w] = *sp;
    m->sp_pending = 1U;
}

static bool is_active(enum sstep_state s)
{
    return (s == SSTEP_STATE_HOLDING) || (s == SSTEP_STATE_MOVING);
}

static bool is_moving(const struct sstep_ctx* m)
{
    return (m->mo.mode != SSTEP_MODE_HOLD);
}

static void control(struct sstep_ctx* m)
{
    struct sstep_sincos sc;
    sstep_real_t iref[2];
    sstep_acc_t ff[2];
    sstep_acc_t vu[2];
    sstep_real_t e[2];
    struct sstep_bridge_out out;
    sstep_acc_t vbus;

    if (m->sp_pending != 0U)
    {
        m->sp_active = (uint8_t)(1U - m->sp_active);
        m->cur = m->sp[m->sp_active];
        m->adv = 0U;
        m->sp_pending = 0U;
    }

    sc = sstep_sin_cos(m->cur.angle);
    iref[0] = sstep_mul(m->cur.i_amp, sc.cos);
    iref[1] = sstep_mul(m->cur.i_amp, sc.sin);
    ff[0] = sstep_acc_from_real(sstep_neg(sstep_mul(m->cur.ff, sc.sin)));
    ff[1] = sstep_acc_from_real(sstep_mul(m->cur.ff, sc.cos));

    if (m->cfg.ctrl.drive_mode == SSTEP_DRIVE_CURRENT)
    {
        for (uint32_t k = 0U; k < 2U; k++)
        {
            e[k] = sstep_sub(iref[k], m->i_meas[k]);
            vu[k] = sstep_acc_add(
                sstep_acc_add(sstep_gain_mul(&m->kp, e[k]), sstep_integ_to_acc(m->integ[k])),
                ff[k]);
        }
    }
    else
    {
        for (uint32_t k = 0U; k < 2U; k++)
        {
            vu[k] = sstep_acc_add(sstep_gain_mul(&m->r_pu, iref[k]), ff[k]);
        }
    }

    vbus = sstep_acc_clamp(sstep_gain_mul_int(&m->adc_v, (int32_t)m->vbus_raw), SSTEP_ACC_ZERO,
                           VBUS_PU_MAX);
    sstep_bridge_map(m->cfg.stage.topology, vu[0], vu[1], &m->cur.inv_vbus, vbus,
                     m->cfg.stage.pwm_period_ticks, &out);

    if (m->cfg.ctrl.drive_mode == SSTEP_DRIVE_CURRENT)
    {
        /* integ += Ki Ts e + Ts / Tt (v_applied - v_requested) */
        for (uint32_t k = 0U; k < 2U; k++)
        {
            m->integ[k] = sstep_integ_add(m->integ[k], &m->ki, e[k]);
            if (out.limited)
            {
                m->integ[k] =
                    sstep_integ_add_acc(m->integ[k], &m->kb, sstep_acc_add(out.v[k], -vu[k]));
            }
        }
        if (m->stall_ticks != 0U)
        {
            sstep_stall_observe(m, &sc, out.v);
        }
    }

    for (uint32_t k = 0U; k < SSTEP_LEGS_MAX; k++)
    {
        m->compare[k] = out.compare[k];
    }
    if (m->cfg.hal.pwm_write(m->cfg.hal.context, m->compare) < 0)
    {
        shutdown(m, SSTEP_FAULT_HAL);
    }
    else if (m->adv < m->ratio)
    {
        m->cur.angle += (sstep_angle_t)m->cur.dangle; /* modulo one turn */
        m->adv++;
    }
    else
    {
        /* the slow loop is late: hold the angle */
    }
}

/* ==============================================================================
 * PUBLIC FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

int sstep_init(struct sstep* drv, const struct sstep_config* cfg)
{
    struct sstep_ctx* m = sstep_ctx_of(drv);
    int result;

    if ((m == NULL) || (cfg == NULL))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else
    {
        result = check_config(cfg);
        if (result == SSTEP_OK)
        {
            *m = (struct sstep_ctx){0}; /* no <string.h> needed */
            m->cfg = *cfg;
            result = derive(m);
            m->state = SSTEP_STATE_DISABLED;
            if (result == SSTEP_OK)
            {
                m->ready = SSTEP_READY;
            }
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_enable(struct sstep* drv)
{
    struct sstep_ctx* m = sstep_ctx_of(drv);
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (m->ready != SSTEP_READY)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else if (m->state == SSTEP_STATE_FAULT)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else if (m->state == SSTEP_STATE_DISABLED)
    {
        struct sstep_setpoint sp;
        m->mo.mode = SSTEP_MODE_HOLD;
        m->mo.vel = 0;
        m->mo.target = m->mo.pos;
        m->integ[0] = SSTEP_ACC_ZERO;
        m->integ[1] = SSTEP_ACC_ZERO;
        m->still = 0U;
        m->hold_active = false;
        sp.angle = raw_angle(m, m->mo.pos) + m->angle_offset;
        sp.dangle = 0;
        sp.i_amp = m->i_run;
        sp.ff = SSTEP_REAL_ZERO;
        sp.inv_vbus = m->inv_vbus;
        m->cur = sp;
        m->adv = 0U;
        m->sp_pending = 0U;
        sstep_stall_reset(m);
        if (m->cfg.hal.output_enable(m->cfg.hal.context, true) < 0)
        {
            shutdown(m, SSTEP_FAULT_HAL);
            result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
        }
        else
        {
            m->state = SSTEP_STATE_HOLDING;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        /* already enabled */
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_disable(struct sstep* drv)
{
    struct sstep_ctx* m = sstep_ctx_of(drv);
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (m->ready != SSTEP_READY)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else
    {
        if (m->state != SSTEP_STATE_FAULT)
        {
            m->state = SSTEP_STATE_DISABLED;
        }
        if (m->cfg.hal.output_enable(m->cfg.hal.context, false) < 0)
        {
            shutdown(m, SSTEP_FAULT_HAL);
        }
        m->mo.mode = SSTEP_MODE_HOLD;
        m->mo.vel = 0;
        m->mo.target = m->mo.pos;
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_fast_loop(struct sstep* drv, const struct sstep_sample* sample)
{
    struct sstep_ctx* m = sstep_ctx_of(drv);
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

#if (SSTEP_CFG_ARG_CHECKS == 1)
    if ((m == NULL) || (sample == NULL))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (m->ready != SSTEP_READY)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else
#endif
    {
        int32_t da = (int32_t)sample->i_a - (int32_t)m->cfg.stage.adc_i_zero;
        int32_t db = (int32_t)sample->i_b - (int32_t)m->cfg.stage.adc_i_zero;
        uint16_t faults = SSTEP_FAULT_NONE;

        m->i_meas[0] = sstep_acc_to_real(sstep_gain_mul_int(&m->adc_i, da));
        m->i_meas[1] = sstep_acc_to_real(sstep_gain_mul_int(&m->adc_i, db));
        m->vbus_raw = sample->vbus;

        if (is_active(m->state))
        {
            int32_t trip = (int32_t)m->i_trip_counts;
            if ((m->cfg.ctrl.drive_mode == SSTEP_DRIVE_CURRENT) &&
                ((da > trip) || (da < -trip) || (db > trip) || (db < -trip)))
            {
                faults |= SSTEP_FAULT_OVERCURRENT;
                if (m->stall_count != 0U)
                {
                    /* the slip can reach the trip before stall_time_ms: the position is lost */
                    faults |= SSTEP_FAULT_STALL;
                }
            }
            if ((m->vbus_max_raw != 0U) && (sample->vbus > m->vbus_max_raw))
            {
                faults |= SSTEP_FAULT_OVERVOLTAGE;
            }
            if ((m->vbus_min_raw != 0U) && (sample->vbus < m->vbus_min_raw))
            {
                faults |= SSTEP_FAULT_UNDERVOLTAGE;
            }

            if (faults != SSTEP_FAULT_NONE)
            {
                shutdown(m, faults);
            }
            else
            {
                control(m);
            }
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_slow_loop(struct sstep* drv)
{
    struct sstep_ctx* m = sstep_ctx_of(drv);
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (m->ready != SSTEP_READY)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else if (is_active(m->state))
    {
        struct sstep_setpoint sp;
        int64_t p0 = m->mo.pos;
        int64_t dp;
        int32_t vel;
        uint8_t flags = sstep_motion_step(&m->mo);
        uint16_t raw = m->vbus_raw;
        bool hold_event = false;

        if ((m->mo.mode == SSTEP_MODE_RUN) && (m->mo.v_run == 0) && (m->mo.vel == 0))
        {
            m->mo.mode = SSTEP_MODE_HOLD; /* stop completed */
            m->mo.target = m->mo.pos;
        }
        dp = m->mo.pos - p0;

        /* run current while moving, hold current after hold_delay periods without motion */
        if (dp != 0)
        {
            m->still = 0U;
            m->hold_active = false;
        }
        else
        {
            m->still++;
            if ((m->still >= m->hold_ticks) && (!m->hold_active))
            {
                m->hold_active = true;
                hold_event = true;
            }
        }

        if (raw != 0U)
        {
            struct sstep_gain inv;
            if (sstep_gain_from_ratio64(
                    (int64_t)m->cfg.stage.adc_full * (int64_t)m->cfg.stage.vbus_nominal_mv,
                    (int64_t)raw * (int64_t)m->cfg.stage.adc_vbus_mv_full, &inv) == SSTEP_OK)
            {
                m->inv_vbus = inv;
            }
        }

        sp.angle = raw_angle(m, p0) + m->angle_offset;
        sp.dangle = (int32_t)((dp * pow2_i64((uint32_t)m->angle_shift)) / (int64_t)m->ratio);
        sp.i_amp = m->hold_active ? m->i_hold : m->i_run;
        vel = (int32_t)div_round(dp * (int64_t)m->cfg.ctrl.slow_loop_hz, SSTEP_POS_ONE);
        sp.ff = gain_apply_i32(&m->ff_gain, vel);
        sp.inv_vbus = m->inv_vbus;
        publish(m, &sp);

        /* a fault raised by the fast loop meanwhile sets faults before the state */
        if (m->faults == SSTEP_FAULT_NONE)
        {
            m->state = is_moving(m) ? SSTEP_STATE_MOVING : SSTEP_STATE_HOLDING;
        }
        else
        {
            m->state = SSTEP_STATE_FAULT;
        }

        if (m->cfg.hal.on_event != NULL)
        {
            if ((flags & SSTEP_MOTION_DONE) != 0U)
            {
                m->cfg.hal.on_event(m->cfg.hal.context, SSTEP_EVENT_MOVE_DONE);
            }
            if (hold_event)
            {
                m->cfg.hal.on_event(m->cfg.hal.context, SSTEP_EVENT_HOLD_CURRENT);
            }
        }

        /* stall decision on the period that just ended, then the command of the next one */
        if (m->stall_ticks != 0U)
        {
            if (sstep_stall_check(m))
            {
                shutdown(m, SSTEP_FAULT_STALL);
            }
            m->vel_cmd = vel;
            m->ff_cmd = sp.ff;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        m->mo.mode = SSTEP_MODE_HOLD;
        m->mo.vel = 0;
        m->mo.target = m->mo.pos;
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_move_to(struct sstep* drv, int32_t position)
{
    struct sstep_ctx* m = sstep_ctx_of(drv);
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (m->ready != SSTEP_READY)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else if (!is_active(m->state))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else
    {
        m->mo.target = (int64_t)position * SSTEP_POS_ONE;
        m->mo.mode = SSTEP_MODE_MOVE;
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_move_by(struct sstep* drv, int32_t delta)
{
    struct sstep_ctx* m = sstep_ctx_of(drv);
    int result;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (m->ready != SSTEP_READY)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else
    {
        int64_t t = div_round(m->mo.target, SSTEP_POS_ONE) + (int64_t)delta;
        if ((t > (int64_t)INT32_MAX) || (t < (int64_t)INT32_MIN))
        {
            result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
        }
        else
        {
            result = sstep_move_to(drv, (int32_t)t);
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_run(struct sstep* drv, int32_t velocity)
{
    struct sstep_ctx* m = sstep_ctx_of(drv);
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (m->ready != SSTEP_READY)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else if ((velocity > (int32_t)m->cfg.ctrl.v_max) || (velocity < -(int32_t)m->cfg.ctrl.v_max))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (!is_active(m->state))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else
    {
        m->mo.v_run = (int32_t)div_round((int64_t)velocity * SSTEP_POS_ONE,
                                         (int64_t)m->cfg.ctrl.slow_loop_hz);
        m->mo.mode = SSTEP_MODE_RUN;
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_stop(struct sstep* drv)
{
    struct sstep_ctx* m = sstep_ctx_of(drv);
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (m->ready != SSTEP_READY)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else if (is_active(m->state) && is_moving(m))
    {
        m->mo.v_run = 0;
        m->mo.mode = SSTEP_MODE_RUN;
    }
    else
    {
        /* nothing to stop */
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_set_position(struct sstep* drv, int32_t position)
{
    struct sstep_ctx* m = sstep_ctx_of(drv);
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (m->ready != SSTEP_READY)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else if (is_moving(m))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else
    {
        int64_t p = (int64_t)position * SSTEP_POS_ONE;
        /* keep the electrical angle: the rotor must not move */
        m->angle_offset += raw_angle(m, m->mo.pos) - raw_angle(m, p);
        m->mo.pos = p;
        m->mo.target = p;
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_set_current(struct sstep* drv, uint32_t run_ma, uint32_t hold_ma)
{
    struct sstep_ctx* m = sstep_ctx_of(drv);
    int result;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (m->ready != SSTEP_READY)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else
    {
        result = set_currents(m, run_ma, hold_ma);
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_set_motion_limits(struct sstep* drv, uint32_t v_max, uint32_t accel, uint32_t decel)
{
    struct sstep_ctx* m = sstep_ctx_of(drv);
    int result;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (m->ready != SSTEP_READY)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else
    {
        result = set_limits(m, v_max, accel, decel);
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_report_fault(struct sstep* drv, uint16_t faults)
{
    struct sstep_ctx* m = sstep_ctx_of(drv);
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (m->ready != SSTEP_READY)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else if (faults != SSTEP_FAULT_NONE)
    {
        shutdown(m, faults);
    }
    else
    {
        /* nothing reported */
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_clear_faults(struct sstep* drv)
{
    struct sstep_ctx* m = sstep_ctx_of(drv);
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (m->ready != SSTEP_READY)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else
    {
        m->faults = SSTEP_FAULT_NONE;
        m->state = SSTEP_STATE_DISABLED;
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_get_status(const struct sstep* drv, struct sstep_status* status)
{
    const struct sstep_ctx* m = sstep_ctx_of_const(drv);
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if ((m == NULL) || (status == NULL))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (m->ready != SSTEP_READY)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else
    {
        int32_t base = (int32_t)m->cfg.stage.i_full_scale_ma;
        status->state = m->state;
        status->faults = m->faults;
        status->position = (int32_t)div_round(m->mo.pos, SSTEP_POS_ONE);
        status->target = (int32_t)div_round(m->mo.target, SSTEP_POS_ONE);
        status->velocity = (int32_t)div_round(
            (int64_t)m->mo.vel * (int64_t)m->cfg.ctrl.slow_loop_hz, SSTEP_POS_ONE);
        status->i_a_ma = sstep_real_to_units(sstep_acc_from_real(m->i_meas[0]), base);
        status->i_b_ma = sstep_real_to_units(sstep_acc_from_real(m->i_meas[1]), base);
        status->vbus_mv = (uint32_t)(((uint64_t)m->vbus_raw * m->cfg.stage.adc_vbus_mv_full) /
                                     m->cfg.stage.adc_full);
        sstep_stall_status(m, status);
    }
    return result;
}

/* ==============================================================================

#include "sstep_math.h"

#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>

#include "sstep_defs.h"
#include "sstep_sin_table.h"

/* ==============================================================================
 * DEFINES & MACROS
 * =============================================================================*/

#define QUADRANT_BITS 30U

#define QUADRANT_MASK 0x3FFFFFFFU

#define FRAC_BITS (QUADRANT_BITS - SSTEP_CFG_SINE_TABLE_BITS)

#define RATIO64_LIMIT ((int64_t)0x4000000000000000)

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE FUNCTION DECLARATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

static sstep_real_t quarter_sin(uint32_t pos);

#if (SSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND == SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FIXED)
static uint32_t bit_length(uint64_t v);
static uint64_t ratio_round(uint64_t n, uint64_t d, uint32_t s);
#endif

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

#if (SSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND == SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FIXED)

static uint32_t bit_length(uint64_t v)
{
    uint64_t x = v;
    uint32_t n = 0U;
    uint32_t step = 32U;
    while (step > 0U)
    {
        if ((x >> step) != 0U)
        {
            x >>= step;
            n += step;
        }
        step >>= 1U;
    }
    return n + (uint32_t)x; /* x is 0 or 1 here */
}

static uint64_t ratio_round(uint64_t n, uint64_t d, uint32_t s)
{
    return ((n << s) + (d / 2U)) / d;
}

static sstep_real_t quarter_sin(uint32_t pos)
{
    uint32_t idx = pos >> FRAC_BITS;
    /* the 15 most significant bits of the fraction (FRAC_BITS >= 20) */
    uint32_t frac_u = (pos >> (FRAC_BITS - 15U)) & 0x7FFFU;
    int32_t frac = (int32_t)frac_u;
    int32_t y0 = (int32_t)sstep_sin_table[idx];
    int32_t dy = (int32_t)sstep_sin_table[idx + 1U] - y0; /* |dy| < 2^10 */
    return (sstep_real_t)(y0 + sstep_asr((dy * frac) + 0x4000, 15U));
}

#else /* SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FLOAT */

#define FRAC_SCALE (1.0f / (float)((uint32_t)1U << FRAC_BITS))

static sstep_real_t quarter_sin(uint32_t pos)
{
    uint32_t idx = pos >> FRAC_BITS;
    float frac = (float)(pos & (((uint32_t)1U << FRAC_BITS) - 1U)) * FRAC_SCALE;
    float y0 = sstep_sin_table[idx];
    return y0 + ((sstep_sin_table[idx + 1U] - y0) * frac);
}

#endif /* SSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND */

/* ==============================================================================
 * PUBLIC FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

struct sstep_sincos sstep_sin_cos(sstep_angle_t angle)
{
    uint32_t quadrant = angle >> QUADRANT_BITS;
    uint32_t pos = angle & QUADRANT_MASK;
    /* cos(pos) = sin(90 deg - pos); one angle LSB (2^-32 turn) less keeps the index
       below N, and makes sin(a + 90 deg) bit-exactly equal to cos(a). */
    sstep_real_t s = quarter_sin(pos);
    sstep_real_t c = quarter_sin(QUADRANT_MASK - pos);
    struct sstep_sincos r;

    switch (quadrant)
    {
        case 0U:
            r.sin = s;
            r.cos = c;
            break;
        case 1U:
            r.sin = c;
            r.cos = sstep_neg(s);
            break;
        case 2U:
            r.sin = sstep_neg(s);
            r.cos = sstep_neg(c);
            break;
        default: /* quadrant 3 */
            r.sin = sstep_neg(c);
            r.cos = s;
            break;
    }
    return r;
}

#if (SSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND == SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FIXED)

int sstep_gain_from_ratio64(int64_t num, int64_t den, struct sstep_gain* gain)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if ((gain == NULL) || (den == 0) || (num >= RATIO64_LIMIT) || (num <= -RATIO64_LIMIT) ||
        (den >= RATIO64_LIMIT) || (den <= -RATIO64_LIMIT))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else
    {
        bool negative = ((num < 0) != (den < 0));
        uint64_t n = (num < 0) ? (uint64_t)(-num) : (uint64_t)num;
        uint64_t d = (den < 0) ? (uint64_t)(-den) : (uint64_t)den;
        uint32_t ld = bit_length(d);
        int32_t s;
        uint64_t m;

        if (ld > 47U)
        {
            /* keep n << s below 2^63; the relative error of d is below 2^-46 */
            uint32_t drop = ld - 47U;
            n >>= drop;
            d >>= drop;
            ld = 47U;
        }

        /* estimate: n * 2^s / d in (2^13, 2^15], then correct by one step */
        s = 14 - (int32_t)bit_length(n) + (int32_t)ld;
        if (s < 0)
        {
            s = 0;
        }
        else if (s > 31)
        {
            s = 31;
        }
        else
        {
            /* in range */
        }
        m = ratio_round(n, d, (uint32_t)s);

        if (m > 32767U)
        {
            if (s == 0)
            {
                result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM; /* |num / den| above 32767 */
            }
            else
            {
                s--;
                m = ratio_round(n, d, (uint32_t)s);
            }
        }
        else if (s < 31)
        {
            uint64_t m2 = ratio_round(n, d, (uint32_t)s + 1U);
            if (m2 <= 32767U)
            {
                s++;
                m = m2;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            /* s = 31: smallest exponent */
        }

        if (result == SSTEP_OK)
        {
            if (m == 0U)
            {
                gain->mant = 0;
                gain->exp = (int8_t)SSTEP_GAIN_EXP_MIN;
            }
            else
            {
                int32_t mi = (int32_t)m;
                gain->mant = (int16_t)(negative ? -mi : mi);
                gain->exp = (int8_t)(15 - s);
            }
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_gain_from_ratio(int32_t num, int32_t den, struct sstep_gain* gain)
{
    return sstep_gain_from_ratio64((int64_t)num, (int64_t)den, gain);
}

int sstep_real_from_ratio(int32_t num, int32_t den, sstep_real_t* out)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if ((out == NULL) || (den == 0))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else
    {
        bool negative = ((num < 0) != (den < 0));
        uint64_t n = (num < 0) ? (uint64_t)(-(int64_t)num) : (uint64_t)num;
        uint64_t d = (den < 0) ? (uint64_t)(-(int64_t)den) : (uint64_t)den;
        uint64_t m = ((n << 15U) + (d / 2U)) / d;
        int32_t v;
        if (m > 32768U)
        {
            m = 32768U; /* saturate before the sign is applied */
        }
        v = (int32_t)m;
        *out = sstep_sat(negative ? -v : v);
    }
    return result;
}

int32_t sstep_real_to_units(sstep_acc_t x, int32_t base)
{
    int64_t p = (int64_t)x * (int64_t)base;
    uint64_t a = (p < 0) ? (uint64_t)(-p) : (uint64_t)p; /* |p| < 2^62 */
    uint64_t m = (a + 0x4000U) >> 15U;
    int64_t v = (p < 0) ? -(int64_t)m : (int64_t)m;
    int32_t result;

    if (v > (int64_t)INT32_MAX)
    {
        result = INT32_MAX;
    }
    else if (v < (int64_t)INT32_MIN)
    {
        result = (int32_t)INT32_MIN;
    }
    else
    {
        result = (int32_t)v;
    }
    return result;
}

#else /* SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FLOAT */

int sstep_gain_from_ratio64(int64_t num, int64_t den, struct sstep_gain* gain)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if ((gain == NULL) || (den == 0) || (num >= RATIO64_LIMIT) || (num <= -RATIO64_LIMIT) ||
        (den >= RATIO64_LIMIT) || (den <= -RATIO64_LIMIT))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else
    {
        float v = (float)num / (float)den;
        float a = (v < 0.0f) ? -v : v;
        /* same limit as the fixed point backend (round(|v|) <= 32767) */
        if (a >= 32767.5f)
        {
            result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
        }
        else
        {
            gain->value = v;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_gain_from_ratio(int32_t num, int32_t den, struct sstep_gain* gain)
{
    return sstep_gain_from_ratio64((int64_t)num, (int64_t)den, gain);
}

int sstep_real_from_ratio(int32_t num, int32_t den, sstep_real_t* out)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if ((out == NULL) || (den == 0))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else
    {
        *out = sstep_sat_f((float)num / (float)den);
    }
    return result;
}

int32_t sstep_real_to_units(sstep_acc_t x, int32_t base)
{
    float v = x * (float)base;
    int32_t result;

    if (v >= 2147483520.0f) /* largest float below 2^31 */
    {
        result = INT32_MAX;
    }
    else if (v <= -2147483648.0f)
    {
        result = (int32_t)INT32_MIN;
    }
    else
    {
        result = (int32_t)((v < 0.0f) ? (v - 0.5f) : (v + 0.5f));
    }
    return result;
}

#endif /* SSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND */

 * Description: Numeric backend: one set of types and operations for fixed point (Q15) and float.

#ifndef SSTEP_MATH_H
#define SSTEP_MATH_H

/* ==============================================================================
 * INCLUDES
 * =============================================================================*/

#include <stdint.h>

#include "sstep_config.h"

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/* ==============================================================================
 * TYPE DEFINITIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

typedef uint32_t sstep_angle_t;

#if (SSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND == SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FIXED)

typedef int16_t sstep_real_t;

typedef int32_t sstep_acc_t;

struct sstep_gain
{
    int16_t mant; 
    int8_t exp;   
};

#define SSTEP_REAL_FRAC_BITS 15

#define SSTEP_REAL_MAX ((sstep_real_t)INT16_MAX)

#define SSTEP_REAL_MIN ((sstep_real_t)INT16_MIN)

#define SSTEP_ACC_MAX ((sstep_acc_t)INT32_MAX)

#define SSTEP_ACC_MIN ((sstep_acc_t)INT32_MIN)

#define SSTEP_ACC_C(x) ((sstep_acc_t)((x) * 32768.0))

#define SSTEP_REAL_ZERO ((sstep_real_t)0)

#define SSTEP_ACC_ZERO ((sstep_acc_t)0)

#define SSTEP_ACC_HALF ((sstep_acc_t)16384)

#define SSTEP_ACC_ONE ((sstep_acc_t)32768)

#define SSTEP_ACC_IN_MAX ((sstep_acc_t)131071)

#define SSTEP_ACC_SCALE_MAX ((sstep_acc_t)65535)

typedef int32_t sstep_integ_t;

#define SSTEP_INTEG_FRAC_BITS 27

#define SSTEP_REAL_C(x)              \
    (((x) >= 1.0) ? SSTEP_REAL_MAX : \
                    (((x) <= -1.0) ? SSTEP_REAL_MIN : (sstep_real_t)((x) * 32768.0)))

#else /* SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FLOAT */

typedef float sstep_real_t;

typedef float sstep_acc_t;

struct sstep_gain
{
    float value; 
};

#define SSTEP_REAL_MAX (0.999969482421875f)

#define SSTEP_REAL_MIN (-1.0f)

#define SSTEP_ACC_MAX (65535.99609375f)

#define SSTEP_ACC_MIN (-65536.0f)

#define SSTEP_ACC_C(x) ((sstep_acc_t)(x))

#define SSTEP_REAL_ZERO (0.0f)

#define SSTEP_ACC_ZERO (0.0f)

#define SSTEP_ACC_HALF (0.5f)

#define SSTEP_ACC_ONE (1.0f)

#define SSTEP_ACC_IN_MAX (3.999969482421875f)

#define SSTEP_ACC_SCALE_MAX (1.999969482421875f)

typedef float sstep_integ_t;

#define SSTEP_REAL_C(x) \
    (((x) >= 1.0) ? SSTEP_REAL_MAX : (((x) <= -1.0) ? SSTEP_REAL_MIN : (sstep_real_t)(x)))

#endif /* SSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND */

#define SSTEP_GAIN_EXP_MIN (-16)

#define SSTEP_GAIN_EXP_MAX 15

struct sstep_sincos
{
    sstep_real_t sin; 
    sstep_real_t cos; 
};

/* ==============================================================================
 * FIXED POINT OPERATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

#if (SSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND == SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FIXED)

static inline int32_t sstep_asr(int32_t x, uint32_t n)
{
    int32_t result;
    uint32_t u;
    if (x >= 0)
    {
        u = (uint32_t)x >> n;
        result = (int32_t)u;
    }
    else
    {
        u = (uint32_t)(-(x + 1)) >> n;
        result = -(int32_t)u - 1;
    }
    return result;
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_sat(int32_t x)
{
    int32_t r = x;
    if (r > (int32_t)INT16_MAX)
    {
        r = (int32_t)INT16_MAX;
    }
    else if (r < (int32_t)INT16_MIN)
    {
        r = (int32_t)INT16_MIN;
    }
    else
    {
        /* in range */
    }
    return (sstep_real_t)r;
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_add(sstep_real_t a, sstep_real_t b)
{
    return sstep_sat((int32_t)a + (int32_t)b);
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_sub(sstep_real_t a, sstep_real_t b)
{
    return sstep_sat((int32_t)a - (int32_t)b);
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_neg(sstep_real_t a)
{
    return sstep_sat(-(int32_t)a);
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_abs(sstep_real_t a)
{
    return sstep_sat((a < 0) ? -(int32_t)a : (int32_t)a);
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_mul(sstep_real_t a, sstep_real_t b)
{
    int32_t p = (int32_t)a * (int32_t)b; /* |p| <= 2^30: no overflow */
    return sstep_sat(sstep_asr(p + 0x4000, 15U));
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_from_real(sstep_real_t a)
{
    return (sstep_acc_t)a;
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_acc_to_real(sstep_acc_t a)
{
    return sstep_sat(a);
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_add(sstep_acc_t a, sstep_acc_t b)
{
    sstep_acc_t r;
    if ((b > 0) && (a > (INT32_MAX - b)))
    {
        r = INT32_MAX;
    }
    else if ((b < 0) && (a < (INT32_MIN - b)))
    {
        r = (int32_t)INT32_MIN;
    }
    else
    {
        r = a + b;
    }
    return r;
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_clamp(sstep_acc_t x, sstep_acc_t lo, sstep_acc_t hi)
{
    sstep_acc_t r = x;
    if (r > hi)
    {
        r = hi;
    }
    else if (r < lo)
    {
        r = lo;
    }
    else
    {
        /* in range */
    }
    return r;
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_gain_mul(const struct sstep_gain* g, sstep_real_t x)
{
    int32_t p = (int32_t)x * (int32_t)g->mant; /* Q30, |p| <= 2^30 */
    int32_t s = 15 - (int32_t)g->exp;          /* 0 .. 31 */
    uint32_t sh = (uint32_t)s;
    int32_t r;
    if (sh == 0U)
    {
        r = p;
    }
    else
    {
        r = sstep_asr(sstep_asr(p, sh - 1U) + 1, 1U); /* round half up, no overflow */
    }
    return r;
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_gain_mul_int(const struct sstep_gain* g, int32_t n)
{
    int32_t p = (int32_t)sstep_sat(n) * (int32_t)g->mant; /* |p| <= 2^30 */
    int32_t e = (int32_t)g->exp;
    int32_t r;
    if (e >= 0)
    {
        int32_t lim = sstep_asr(INT32_MAX, (uint32_t)e);
        if (p > lim)
        {
            r = INT32_MAX;
        }
        else if (p < -lim)
        {
            r = (int32_t)INT32_MIN;
        }
        else
        {
            uint32_t pw = (uint32_t)1U << (uint32_t)e;
            r = p * (int32_t)pw; /* |p| <= lim: no overflow */
        }
    }
    else
    {
        uint32_t sh = (uint32_t)(-e); /* 1 .. 16 */
        r = sstep_asr(sstep_asr(p, sh - 1U) + 1, 1U);
    }
    return r;
}


static inline int32_t sstep_shift_round(int32_t p, int32_t sh)
{
    int32_t r;
    if (sh > 0)
    {
        uint32_t n = (uint32_t)sh;
        r = sstep_asr(sstep_asr(p, n - 1U) + 1, 1U);
    }
    else if (sh == 0)
    {
        r = p;
    }
    else
    {
        uint32_t n = (uint32_t)(-sh);
        int32_t lim = sstep_asr(INT32_MAX, n);
        if (p > lim)
        {
            r = INT32_MAX;
        }
        else if (p < -lim)
        {
            r = (int32_t)INT32_MIN;
        }
        else
        {
            uint32_t pw = (uint32_t)1U << n;
            r = p * (int32_t)pw; /* |p| <= lim: no overflow */
        }
    }
    return r;
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_abs(sstep_acc_t a)
{
    return (a < 0) ? ((a == INT32_MIN) ? INT32_MAX : -a) : a;
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_halve(sstep_acc_t a)
{
    return sstep_asr(a, 1U);
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_in(sstep_acc_t x)
{
    return sstep_acc_clamp(x, -SSTEP_ACC_IN_MAX, SSTEP_ACC_IN_MAX);
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_gain_mul_acc(const struct sstep_gain* g, sstep_acc_t x)
{
    int32_t p = sstep_asr(sstep_acc_in(x), 2U) * (int32_t)g->mant; /* |p| < 2^30 */
    return sstep_shift_round(p, 13 - (int32_t)g->exp);
}

static inline sstep_integ_t sstep_integ_add(sstep_integ_t integ, const struct sstep_gain* g,
                                            sstep_real_t x)
{
    int32_t p = (int32_t)x * (int32_t)g->mant; /* Q30, |p| <= 2^30 */
    return sstep_acc_add(integ, sstep_shift_round(p, 3 - (int32_t)g->exp));
}

static inline sstep_integ_t sstep_integ_add_acc(sstep_integ_t integ, const struct sstep_gain* g,
                                                sstep_acc_t x)
{
    int32_t p = sstep_asr(sstep_acc_in(x), 2U) * (int32_t)g->mant;
    return sstep_acc_add(integ, sstep_shift_round(p, 1 - (int32_t)g->exp));
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_integ_to_acc(sstep_integ_t integ)
{
    return sstep_shift_round(integ, SSTEP_INTEG_FRAC_BITS - SSTEP_REAL_FRAC_BITS);
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_div_unit(sstep_acc_t num, sstep_acc_t den)
{
    uint32_t n = (uint32_t)num;
    uint32_t d = (uint32_t)den;
    uint32_t r;
    while (d >= 65536U) /* at most 16 iterations; keeps n << 15 below 2^31 */
    {
        n >>= 1U;
        d >>= 1U;
    }
    r = ((n << 15U) + (d >> 1U)) / d;
    if (r > 32767U)
    {
        r = 32767U;
    }
    return (sstep_real_t)r;
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_scale(sstep_acc_t x, sstep_real_t k)
{
    int32_t xc = sstep_acc_clamp(x, -SSTEP_ACC_SCALE_MAX, SSTEP_ACC_SCALE_MAX);
    return sstep_shift_round(xc * (int32_t)k, 15); /* |xc * k| < 2^31 */
}

static inline uint16_t sstep_acc_to_ticks(sstep_acc_t duty, uint16_t period)
{
    uint32_t d = (uint32_t)sstep_acc_clamp(duty, 0, SSTEP_ACC_ONE);
    return (uint16_t)(((d * (uint32_t)period) + 16384U) >> 15U);
}

/* ==============================================================================
 * FLOAT OPERATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

#else /* SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FLOAT */

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_sat_f(float x)
{
    float r = x;
    if (r > SSTEP_REAL_MAX)
    {
        r = SSTEP_REAL_MAX;
    }
    else if (r < SSTEP_REAL_MIN)
    {
        r = SSTEP_REAL_MIN;
    }
    else
    {
        /* in range */
    }
    return r;
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_add(sstep_real_t a, sstep_real_t b)
{
    return sstep_sat_f(a + b);
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_sub(sstep_real_t a, sstep_real_t b)
{
    return sstep_sat_f(a - b);
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_neg(sstep_real_t a)
{
    return sstep_sat_f(-a);
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_abs(sstep_real_t a)
{
    return sstep_sat_f((a < 0.0f) ? -a : a);
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_mul(sstep_real_t a, sstep_real_t b)
{
    return sstep_sat_f(a * b);
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_from_real(sstep_real_t a)
{
    return a;
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_acc_to_real(sstep_acc_t a)
{
    return sstep_sat_f(a);
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_clamp(sstep_acc_t x, sstep_acc_t lo, sstep_acc_t hi)
{
    sstep_acc_t r = x;
    if (r > hi)
    {
        r = hi;
    }
    else if (r < lo)
    {
        r = lo;
    }
    else
    {
        /* in range */
    }
    return r;
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_add(sstep_acc_t a, sstep_acc_t b)
{
    return sstep_acc_clamp(a + b, SSTEP_ACC_MIN, SSTEP_ACC_MAX);
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_gain_mul(const struct sstep_gain* g, sstep_real_t x)
{
    return sstep_acc_clamp(g->value * x, SSTEP_ACC_MIN, SSTEP_ACC_MAX);
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_gain_mul_int(const struct sstep_gain* g, int32_t n)
{
    int32_t k = n;
    if (k > (int32_t)INT16_MAX)
    {
        k = (int32_t)INT16_MAX;
    }
    else if (k < (int32_t)INT16_MIN)
    {
        k = (int32_t)INT16_MIN;
    }
    else
    {
        /* in range */
    }
    return sstep_acc_clamp(g->value * (float)k, SSTEP_ACC_MIN, SSTEP_ACC_MAX);
}


static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_abs(sstep_acc_t a)
{
    return (a < 0.0f) ? -a : a;
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_halve(sstep_acc_t a)
{
    return a * 0.5f;
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_in(sstep_acc_t x)
{
    return sstep_acc_clamp(x, -SSTEP_ACC_IN_MAX, SSTEP_ACC_IN_MAX);
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_gain_mul_acc(const struct sstep_gain* g, sstep_acc_t x)
{
    return sstep_acc_clamp(g->value * sstep_acc_in(x), SSTEP_ACC_MIN, SSTEP_ACC_MAX);
}

static inline sstep_integ_t sstep_integ_add(sstep_integ_t integ, const struct sstep_gain* g,
                                            sstep_real_t x)
{
    return sstep_acc_clamp(integ + (g->value * x), -16.0f, 15.999999f);
}

static inline sstep_integ_t sstep_integ_add_acc(sstep_integ_t integ, const struct sstep_gain* g,
                                                sstep_acc_t x)
{
    return sstep_acc_clamp(integ + (g->value * sstep_acc_in(x)), -16.0f, 15.999999f);
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_integ_to_acc(sstep_integ_t integ)
{
    return integ;
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_div_unit(sstep_acc_t num, sstep_acc_t den)
{
    return sstep_sat_f(num / den);
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_scale(sstep_acc_t x, sstep_real_t k)
{
    return sstep_acc_clamp(x, -SSTEP_ACC_SCALE_MAX, SSTEP_ACC_SCALE_MAX) * k;
}

static inline uint16_t sstep_acc_to_ticks(sstep_acc_t duty, uint16_t period)
{
    float d = sstep_acc_clamp(duty, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    return (uint16_t)((d * (float)period) + 0.5f);
}

#endif /* SSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND */

/* ==============================================================================
 * COMMON OPERATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

docs.text:
Velocity the profile aims at in this period. 

static int32_t target_velocity (
    const struct sstep_motion * mo
)

A move aims at the largest v_new for which the distance of this period, (v + v_new) / 2, plus the braking distance from v_new, v_new^2 / (2 dec), fits into the distance left: v_new = (-dec + sqrt(dec^2 + 8 dec |rem| - 4 dec |v|)) / 2. No overshoot; the velocity changes by at most acc or dec per period, except in the last period of a move, where the remaining v <= 2 dec (a few microsteps per second) drops to zero on the target.

 * Stepper-C: Stepper Motor Control Implementation
 *
 * Project:     Stepper-C - Hardware-Agnostic Stepper Motor Control Library
 * Description: Motion generator: trapezoidal velocity profile in integer arithmetic (slow loop).
 *
 * Author:      Anton Vynohradov

/* ==============================================================================
 * INCLUDES
 * =============================================================================*/

#include "sstep_internal.h"

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE FUNCTION DECLARATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

static int32_t clamp_i32(int32_t v, int32_t lo, int32_t hi);
static int32_t abs_i32(int32_t v);
static int64_t abs_i64(int64_t v);
static int64_t half_floor(int64_t v);
static int32_t target_velocity(const struct sstep_motion* mo);

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

static int32_t clamp_i32(int32_t v, int32_t lo, int32_t hi)
{
    int32_t r = v;
    if (r > hi)
    {
        r = hi;
    }
    else if (r < lo)
    {
        r = lo;
    }
    else
    {
        /* in range */
    }
    return r;
}

static int32_t abs_i32(int32_t v)
{
    return (v < 0) ? -v : v;
}

static int64_t abs_i64(int64_t v)
{
    return (v < 0) ? -v : v;
}

static int64_t half_floor(int64_t v)
{
    return (v >= 0) ? (v / 2) : -((1 - v) / 2);
}

static int32_t target_velocity(const struct sstep_motion* mo)
{
    int32_t vt;

    if (mo->mode == SSTEP_MODE_MOVE)
    {
        int64_t rem = mo->target - mo->pos;
        int64_t arem = abs_i64(rem);
        int64_t av = (int64_t)abs_i32(mo->vel);
        int64_t d = (int64_t)mo->dec;
        uint32_t mag;

        if (arem >= (mo->brake_vmax + (((int64_t)mo->v_max + av) / 2)))
        {
            mag = (uint32_t)mo->v_max;
        }
        else
        {
            /* arem < v_max^2 / (2 dec) + v_max: every term below 2^62. The root is below
               v_max here (it reaches v_max exactly at the threshold above). */
            int64_t disc = (d * d) + (8 * d * arem) - (4 * d * av);
            uint32_t root = (disc > 0) ? sstep_isqrt64((uint64_t)disc) : 0U;
            mag = (root > (uint32_t)d) ? ((root - (uint32_t)d) / 2U) : 0U;
        }

        if (rem > 0)
        {
            vt = (int32_t)mag;
        }
        else if (rem < 0)
        {
            vt = -(int32_t)mag;
        }
        else
        {
            vt = 0;
        }
    }
    else if (mo->mode == SSTEP_MODE_RUN)
    {
        vt = clamp_i32(mo->v_run, -mo->v_max, mo->v_max);
    }
    else
    {
        vt = 0;
    }
    return vt;
}

/* ==============================================================================
 * PUBLIC FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS (library internal)
 * =============================================================================*/

uint32_t sstep_isqrt64(uint64_t x)
{
    uint64_t rem = x;
    uint64_t res = 0U;
    uint64_t bit = (uint64_t)1U << 62U;

    while (bit > rem)
    {
        bit >>= 2U;
    }
    while (bit != 0U)
    {
        if (rem >= (res + bit))
        {
            rem -= res + bit;
            res = (res >> 1U) + bit;
        }
        else
        {
            res >>= 1U;
        }
        bit >>= 2U;
    }
    return (uint32_t)res;
}

uint8_t sstep_motion_step(struct sstep_motion* mo)
{
    uint8_t result = 0U;
    int32_t vt = target_velocity(mo);
    /* speeding up: larger magnitude in the same direction (or from standstill) */
    bool speeding_up =
        (abs_i32(vt) > abs_i32(mo->vel)) && ((mo->vel == 0) || ((vt > 0) == (mo->vel > 0)));
    int32_t a = speeding_up ? mo->acc : mo->dec;
    int32_t v_new = mo->vel + clamp_i32(vt - mo->vel, -a, a);
    int64_t p_new = mo->pos + half_floor((int64_t)mo->vel + (int64_t)v_new);

    if (mo->mode == SSTEP_MODE_MOVE)
    {
        int64_t rem0 = mo->target - mo->pos;
        int64_t rem1 = mo->target - p_new;
        bool crossed = ((rem0 >= 0) && (rem1 <= 0)) || ((rem0 <= 0) && (rem1 >= 0));
        bool near = (abs_i64(rem1) < SSTEP_POS_SNAP) && (abs_i32(v_new) <= mo->dec);
        if (crossed || near)
        {
            p_new = mo->target;
            v_new = 0;
            mo->mode = SSTEP_MODE_HOLD;
            result = SSTEP_MOTION_DONE;
        }
    }

    mo->pos = p_new;
    mo->vel = v_new;
    return result;
}

/* ==============================================================================
 * INCLUDES
 * =============================================================================*/

#include "sstep_internal.h"

/* ==============================================================================
 * DEFINES & MACROS
 * =============================================================================*/

#define TWO_PI_NUM 710U
#define TWO_PI_DEN 113U

#define CORDIC_STEPS 16U

#define CORDIC_NORM ((int32_t)0x08000000)

#define HALF_TURN 0x80000000U

#define TURN ((int64_t)4294967296)

#define OFF_ONE ((int64_t)65536)

#define CDEG_PER_TURN 36000

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE FUNCTION DECLARATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

static int32_t emf_mv(const struct sstep_ctx* m, uint32_t axis);
static int64_t abs_i64(int64_t v);
static uint64_t muldiv_u64(uint64_t a, uint64_t b, uint64_t d);
static sstep_angle_t atan2_turn(int32_t y, int32_t x);

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

static int32_t emf_mv(const struct sstep_ctx* m, uint32_t axis)
{
    return sstep_real_to_units(sstep_integ_to_acc(m->emf[axis]),
                               (int32_t)m->cfg.stage.vbus_nominal_mv);
}

static int64_t abs_i64(int64_t v)
{
    return (v < 0) ? -v : v;
}

static uint64_t muldiv_u64(uint64_t a, uint64_t b, uint64_t d)
{
    uint64_t q = a / d;
    uint64_t r = a % d;
    return (q * b) + ((r * b) / d);
}

static sstep_angle_t atan2_turn(int32_t y, int32_t x)
{
    /* atan(2^-i) in 2^-32 turn, i = 0 .. CORDIC_STEPS - 1. Read-only (flash). */
    static const uint32_t atan_table[CORDIC_STEPS] = {
        536870912U, 316933406U, 167458907U, 85004756U, 42667331U, 21354465U, 10679838U, 5340245U,
        2670163U,   1335087U,   667544U,    333772U,   166886U,   83443U,    41722U,    20861U};
    int32_t xs = x;
    int32_t ys = y;
    int32_t pw = 1; /* 2^i */
    sstep_angle_t a = 0U;
    uint32_t steps = CORDIC_STEPS;

    if ((x == 0) && (y == 0))
    {
        steps = 0U; /* the zero vector: angle 0 */
    }
    if (xs < 0)
    {
        /* rotate by half a turn into the right half plane */
        xs = -xs;
        ys = -ys;
        a = HALF_TURN;
    }
    while ((steps != 0U) && (xs < CORDIC_NORM) && (ys < CORDIC_NORM) && (ys > -CORDIC_NORM))
    {
        xs *= 2; /* at most 27 times */
        ys *= 2;
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0U; i < steps; i++)
    {
        int32_t dx = ys / pw; /* truncates toward zero for either sign */
        int32_t dy = xs / pw;
        if (ys >= 0)
        {
            xs += dx;
            ys -= dy;
            a += atan_table[i];
        }
        else
        {
            xs -= dx;
            ys += dy;
            a -= atan_table[i];
        }
        pw *= 2;
    }
    return a;
}

/* ==============================================================================
 * PUBLIC FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS (library internal)
 * =============================================================================*/

void sstep_stall_reset(struct sstep_ctx* m)
{
    for (uint32_t k = 0U; k < 2U; k++)
    {
        m->i_prev[k] = m->i_meas[k];
        m->v_hist[0][k] = SSTEP_ACC_ZERO;
        m->v_hist[1][k] = SSTEP_ACC_ZERO;
        m->emf[k] = SSTEP_ACC_ZERO;
        m->emf_off[k] = 0;
    }
    m->vel_cmd = 0;
    m->ff_cmd = SSTEP_REAL_ZERO;
    m->stall_count = 0U;
    m->stall_hold = 0U;
}

void sstep_stall_observe(struct sstep_ctx* m, const struct sstep_sincos* sc,
                         const sstep_acc_t v_applied[2])
{
    sstep_real_t e[2];
    sstep_acc_t ed;
    sstep_acc_t eq;

    /* e = v(k-2) - R (i(k) + i(k-1)) / 2 - L (i(k) - i(k-1)) / Ts
         = v(k-2) - (L / Ts + R / 2) i(k) + (L / Ts - R / 2) i(k-1), per phase, in +/-1 pu */
    for (uint32_t k = 0U; k < 2U; k++)
    {
        sstep_acc_t x = sstep_acc_add(m->v_hist[1][k], -sstep_gain_mul(&m->emf_a, m->i_meas[k]));
        e[k] = sstep_acc_to_real(sstep_acc_add(x, sstep_gain_mul(&m->emf_b, m->i_prev[k])));
        m->i_prev[k] = m->i_meas[k];
        m->v_hist[1][k] = m->v_hist[0][k];
        m->v_hist[0][k] = v_applied[k];
    }

    /* into the commanded frame: d along the current reference, q 90 deg ahead */
    ed = sstep_acc_from_real(sstep_add(sstep_mul(e[0], sc->cos), sstep_mul(e[1], sc->sin)));
    eq = sstep_acc_from_real(sstep_sub(sstep_mul(e[1], sc->cos), sstep_mul(e[0], sc->sin)));

    /* first-order low-pass: y += Ts / tau (x - y) */
    m->emf[0] = sstep_integ_add_acc(m->emf[0], &m->emf_alpha,
                                    sstep_acc_add(ed, -sstep_integ_to_acc(m->emf[0])));
    m->emf[1] = sstep_integ_add_acc(m->emf[1], &m->emf_alpha,
                                    sstep_acc_add(eq, -sstep_integ_to_acc(m->emf[1])));
}

bool sstep_stall_check(struct sstep_ctx* m)
{
    int64_t ed = (int64_t)emf_mv(m, 0U);
    int64_t eq = (int64_t)emf_mv(m, 1U);
    /* expected back-EMF of the command, on the q axis: Ke w (signed) */
    int64_t eref = (int64_t)sstep_real_to_units(sstep_acc_from_real(m->ff_cmd),
                                                (int32_t)m->cfg.stage.vbus_nominal_mv);
    int64_t vel = (int64_t)m->vel_cmd;
    bool bad;

    if (abs_i64(vel) >= (int64_t)m->cfg.ctrl.stall_speed)
    {
        /* in motion: back-EMF along the commanded motion below sync_pct of Ke w, with the
           d axis inside the window of a rotor that does not turn: resistance error only
           (mostly positive), so that a rotor under load is not taken for a blocked one */
        int64_t along = (vel > 0) ? eq : -eq;
        int64_t er = abs_i64(eref);
        int64_t ri = ((int64_t)m->cfg.motor.r_mohm * (int64_t)m->cfg.ctrl.i_run_ma) / 1000;
        bad = ((along * 100) < ((int64_t)m->cfg.ctrl.stall_sync_pct * er)) &&
              (ed <= ((er / 3) + ((ri * 2) / 5))) && (ed >= -((er / 3) + (ri / 10)));
        /* a reversed back-EMF is beyond the pull-out: a slipping rotor passes here once per
           turn of the vector, and the condition stays true in between */
        if ((along * 2) < -(er + (2 * (int64_t)m->stall_emf_mv)))
        {
            m->stall_hold = m->stall_ticks / 2U;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        /* at rest or slow: the rotor turns faster than the command by more than
           stall_speed. The deviation from the expected back-EMF averages zero while the
           rotor follows: its running mean (time constant stall_time) is the observer error
           (resistance, dead time) and is subtracted; a slip makes the vector rotate. */
        int64_t lim = (int64_t)m->stall_emf_mv;
        int64_t dev[2];
        dev[0] = ed;
        dev[1] = eq - eref;
        for (uint32_t k = 0U; k < 2U; k++)
        {
            m->emf_off[k] += ((dev[k] * OFF_ONE) - m->emf_off[k]) / (int64_t)m->stall_ticks;
            dev[k] -= m->emf_off[k] / OFF_ONE;
        }
        bad = (((dev[0] * dev[0]) + (dev[1] * dev[1])) > (lim * lim));
    }

    if (m->stall_hold != 0U)
    {
        m->stall_hold--;
        bad = true;
    }

    if (bad)
    {
        m->stall_count++;
    }
    else if (m->stall_count > 0U)
    {
        m->stall_count--;
    }
    else
    {
        /* idle */
    }
    return (m->stall_count >= m->stall_ticks);
}

void sstep_stall_status(const struct sstep_ctx* m, struct sstep_status* status)
{
    if (m->stall_ticks == 0U)
    {
        status->emf_d_mv = 0;
        status->emf_q_mv = 0;
        status->rotor_velocity = 0;
        status->load_angle_cdeg = 0;
        status->stall_level_pct = 0U;
    }
    else
    {
        int64_t ed = (int64_t)emf_mv(m, 0U);
        int64_t eq = (int64_t)emf_mv(m, 1U);
        /* direction of the command, or of the back-EMF at rest */
        int64_t s = 1;
        if ((m->vel_cmd < 0) || ((m->vel_cmd == 0) && (eq < 0)))
        {
            s = -1;
        }
        int64_t sq = (ed * ed) + (eq * eq);
        uint64_t mag = sstep_isqrt64((uint64_t)sq);
        /* speed = |e| / Ke [microsteps/s] = |e| Ns M / (2 pi Ke) */
        uint64_t ns_m =
            (uint64_t)m->cfg.motor.full_steps_per_rev * (uint64_t)m->cfg.ctrl.microsteps;
        uint64_t speed = muldiv_u64(mag * 1000U * TWO_PI_DEN, ns_m,
                                    (uint64_t)TWO_PI_NUM * m->cfg.motor.ke_uv_s_per_rad);
        sstep_angle_t a = atan2_turn((int32_t)(s * ed), (int32_t)(s * eq)); /* |e| < 2^24 */
        int64_t a_signed = (int64_t)a - ((a >= HALF_TURN) ? TURN : 0);
        int64_t v = (speed > (uint64_t)INT32_MAX) ? (int64_t)INT32_MAX : (int64_t)speed;

        status->emf_d_mv = (int32_t)ed;
        status->emf_q_mv = (int32_t)eq;
        status->rotor_velocity = (int32_t)((eq >= 0) ? v : -v);
        status->load_angle_cdeg = (int32_t)((a_signed * CDEG_PER_TURN) / TURN);
        /* the counter stops at the trip (the outputs are off): at most 100 % */
        status->stall_level_pct = (uint8_t)(((uint64_t)m->stall_count * 100U) / m->stall_ticks);
    }
}
